app.name: Reverbland
app.tagline: Neon music player with sound effects
app.desc: Reverbland is a simple neon music player. Add your own songs, play them with effects like Nightcore, Slowed, Reverb and Sped Up, save your settings, and export your favorite version as a file to share with friends. Your music stays on your phone.

priv.title: Privacy
priv.body:
Your songs, covers and settings are stored only on this phone and are never sent to any server.
The app works offline. Only the first MP3 export downloads the MP3 tool from the internet, and your songs are not sent anywhere during that.
You can remove songs any time from Manage music files.
help.title: How to use
help.body:
1. Tap Add songs and choose your songs from the phone.
2. Tap a song to play it, then tap the bar at the bottom to open the player.
3. Under Sound effects, tap a preset or set speed and reverb yourself.
4. Save song settings to remember the effect for that song.
5. Use the three-dot menu or the download button in the player to export, then save the file or share it with friends.
6. The volume under the play buttons changes only the music, not your game or other apps. Set the phone volume for your game and lower the music here.
7. The waves button next to search opens ambient sounds like rain and fire.
8. Whatever you build in the player (effect plus ambient sounds) is saved into the file with the export button.
